rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for cutting and gathering grain or another crop.

example.english: Every autumn, the villagers reap the rice.
example.traditional: 每年秋天村民都忙住收割稻米。
example.jyutping: mui5 nin4 cau1 tin1 cyun1 man4 dou1 mong4 zyu6 sau1 got3 dou6 mai5

rows.note: Use this when what someone reaps is positive: effort produces a benefit or reward.

example.english: If you work hard at school, you will reap rewards later.
example.traditional: 你肯落力讀書，將來就會得到回報。
example.jyutping: nei5 hang2 lok6 lik6 duk6 syu1 zoeng1 loi4 zau6 wui5 dak1 dou3 wui4 bou3

rows.note: Use this when what someone reaps is negative: they suffer the consequences of their own actions.

example.english: Those investors made reckless investments back then and now reap the consequences.
example.traditional: 那些投資者當年胡亂投資，如今終於自食其果。
example.jyutping: naa5 se1 tau4 zi1 ze2 dong1 nin4 wu4 lyun6 tau4 zi1 jyu4 gam1 zung1 jyu1 zi6 sik6 kei4 gwo2
